name: The Mark of Merope
source:
Come closer, and let me tell you a tale. Of lost Merope, who hides her shame from her sisters. Of the doom she witnessed. And of the fate that awaits should you meet her gaze...

This is a love story, and a cautionary tale.

[From [url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/the-mark-of-merope]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
靠近一点，我给你讲个故事。迷失的梅洛普，她向姐妹们隐瞒了自己的耻辱。她目睹的厄运。如果你与她的目光相遇，等待着你的命运……

这是一个爱情故事，也是一个警示故事。

[来自[url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/the-mark-of-merope]itch.io[/url]]
